meta_description: One account for all your Kete apps.
brand_tagline: Tools of tomorrow for better productivity
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
auth_intro: One account for all your Kete apps.
auth_error_sign_up: An account cannot be created with these details.
auth_mail_notice: E-mail verification and password reset will come with e-mail delivery.
org_create_intro: Your company, your dry cleaning shop, your workshop: the space your teams share.
tools_soon: Subscriptions are coming soon: each tool will be activated here.
members_invite_link: Invitation created. Share this link with the invited person:
members_only_admins: Only owners and administrators can invite.
invitation_sign_in_first: Sign in, or create your account with the invited address, to accept.
invitation_invalid: This invitation is no longer valid.
settings_intro: Entered once, used by all your Kete apps.
settings_read_only: Only owners and administrators can change these settings.
invitation_wrong_account: This invitation is not for this account, or is no longer valid.
auth_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
settings_logo_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 5 MB at most. The image is checked and cleaned before it is shown.
file_error_too_large: This file is too large: 5 MB at most.
file_error_unsupported_type: This file is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
file_error_unreadable: This image is unreadable or incomplete.
file_error_missing: The upload did not arrive. Try again.
billing_intro: Each tool is paid for a period. Paying before it ends extends access without interruption.
billing_only_admins: Only owners and administrators can pay.
billing_phone_hint: The number used to pay, without the country code.
billing_paid: Payment confirmed. Access is open until {date}.
billing_pending: The payment is not confirmed yet.
billing_failed: The payment did not go through.
billing_rejected: Payment received but different from the offer: the Kete team checks it before opening access.
billing_provider_unavailable: The payment service is not answering. Try again in a moment.
billing_offer_refused: This offer cannot be paid for at the moment. The Kete team is informed.
two_factor_code_intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.
security_intro: Protect your account with a second factor. Kete operators must use one.
security_scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
security_backup_codes: Backup codes — keep them safe, each works once:
consent_text: The application “{client}” asks to access your Kete account.
auth_link_expired: This link is no longer valid: it was already used or it expired. Ask for a new one from your conversation.
billing_receipt_email_hint: Your account has no e-mail: the payment receipt goes to this address.
billing_invalid_email: This e-mail address is not valid.
auth_error_passkey: The passkey was not accepted. Try again, or sign in with your password.
security_passkeys_intro: A passkey signs you in without a password: your password manager (Bitwarden…) or your device keeps it and offers it.
security_passkey_refused: That did not go through. Try again.
security_last_passkey: It is your only way to sign in: add another passkey first.
security_password_remove: Sign in with my passkeys only
security_password_remove_confirm: Your password will be deleted: you will sign in with your passkeys only. Continue?
security_password_removed: Your account has no password any more: you sign in with your passkeys.
security_passkey_only: Your account signs in with your passkeys only.
forgot_intro: Enter your account's address: we send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot_sent: If an account exists at this address, an e-mail has just left. The link is valid for one hour.
reset_intro: Choose a new password of at least 10 characters. Your other sessions will be closed.
reset_done: Your password is changed. You can sign in.
reset_invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new link.
reset_error: The password could not be changed. Check it has at least 10 characters.
email_footer: Kete — Tomorrow's tools for better productivity. If you did not expect this message, ignore it.
email_invitation_body: {inviter} invites you to join {organization} on Kete. The link is valid for 7 days.
email_reset_body: A new password was requested for your Kete account. The link is valid for one hour.
email_reset_unavailable_subject: Your Kete account has no password
email_reset_unavailable_body: A new password was requested for your Kete account. Your account signs in with a passkey or your phone number: it has no password to reset. You can add one from Mon espace Kete, once signed in.
